25: import os
26: import shutil
27: import time
28: import sys
29: 
30: from . import filesystem
31: from .. import ical
32: 
33: 
34: class Collection(filesystem.Collection):
35:     """Collection stored in several files per calendar."""
36:     def _create_dirs(self):
37:         if not os.path.exists(self._path):
38:             os.makedirs(self._path)
39: 
40:     @property
41:     def headers(self):
42:         return (
43:             ical.Header("PRODID:-//Radicale//NONSGML Radicale Server//EN"),
44:             ical.Header("VERSION:%s" % self.version))
45: 
46:     def write(self, headers=None, items=None):
47:         self._create_dirs()
48:         headers = headers or self.headers
49:         items = items if items is not None else self.items
50:         timezones = list(set(i for i in items if isinstance(i, ical.Timezone)))
51:         components = [i for i in items if isinstance(i, ical.Component)]
52:         for component in components:
53:             text = ical.serialize(self.tag, headers, [component] + timezones)
54:             name = (
55:                 component.name if sys.version_info[0] >= 3 else
56:                 component.name.encode(filesystem.FILESYSTEM_ENCODING))
57:             path = os.path.join(self._path, name)
58:             with filesystem.open(path, "w") as fd:
59:                 fd.write(text)
60: 
61:     def delete(self):
62:         shutil.rmtree(self._path)
63:         os.remove(self._props_path)
64: 
65:     def remove(self, name):
66:         if os.path.exists(os.path.join(self._path, name)):
67:             os.remove(os.path.join(self._path, name))
68: 
69:     @property
70:     def text(self):
71:         components = (
72:             ical.Timezone, ical.Event, ical.Todo, ical.Journal, ical.Card)
73:         items = set()
74:         try:
75:             for filename in os.listdir(self._path):
76:                 with filesystem.open(os.path.join(self._path, filename)) as fd:
77:                     items.update(self._parse(fd.read(), components))
78:         except IOError:
79:             return ""
80:         else:
81:             return ical.serialize(
82:                 self.tag, self.headers, sorted(items, key=lambda x: x.name))
83: 
84:     @classmethod
85:     def is_node(cls, path):
86:         path = os.path.join(filesystem.FOLDER, path.replace("/", os.sep))
87:         return os.path.isdir(path) and not os.path.exists(path + ".props")
88: 
89:     @classmethod
90:     def is_leaf(cls, path):
91:         path = os.path.join(filesystem.FOLDER, path.replace("/", os.sep))
92:         return os.path.isdir(path) and os.path.exists(path + ".props")
93: 
94:     @property
95:     def last_modified(self):
96:         last = max([
97:             os.path.getmtime(os.path.join(self._path, filename))
98:             for filename in os.listdir(self._path)] or [0])
99:         return time.strftime("%a, %d %b %Y %H:%M:%S +0000", time.gmtime(last))

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Improper Link Resolution Before File Access ('Link Following')
top_sast_rules.description: File access follows a symlink, hardlink, or shortcut to an unintended resource.
top_sast_rules.pattern: cwe-59 symlink hardlink link-following symbolic-link file-link archive-extraction path-resolution file-overwrite race filesystem
top_sast_rules.remediation: Reject unsafe links and verify resolved file targets before access.

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')
top_sast_rules.description: Extracting files from a malicious ZIP file, or similar type of archive, without validating that the destination file path is within the destination directory can allow an attacker to unexpectedly gain access to resources.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Look for security-sensitive operations that handle user input without proper validation or sanitization
top_sast_rules.remediation: Implement path validation using canonical paths. Reject paths containing '../' or similar traversal sequences.
